items.name: workspace
items.title: Workspace
items.description: An ink frame with sibling navigation and paper panes. Local padding for reading and compact lists, without imposing product navigation or scroll behavior.

items.name: app-frame
items.title: App Frame
items.description: A product window as one canvas: navigation, lists and a tool rail on it, the work in hand on a single inset sheet with a two-row header and a docked box at its foot.

items.name: theme
items.title: Abnormal Theme
items.description: Color, type, radius and motion tokens, with light and dark values. Import abnormal.css once after Tailwind.

items.name: fonts
items.title: Abnormal Fonts
items.description: @font-face rules for projects without next/font. The woff2 files are served at /fonts.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn class merger, taught the theme's custom radius, shadow and animation names.

items.name: template
items.title: Template
items.description: fillTemplate and the Template type: copy strings with {name} slots, whose slot names the compiler checks against what each component passes.

items.name: eslint-plugin
items.title: ESLint Plugin
items.description: Lint rules that keep hand-picked colors, font sizes, spacing, radii, shadows and layers out of classes and CSS, pointing at the theme's names instead.

items.name: brand-mark
items.title: Brand Mark
items.description: The abnormal tile, the wordmark and the mark's arrow.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A highlighter stroke under a number or a single word.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open in place as a group, one or several at a time, with arrow keys between the headers.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline notice with an icon, title and description.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal confirmation that interrupts the flow.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or workspace as a picture, with initials until it loads or when it cannot.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small chip for counts, domains and roles, in two sizes, with a capped count and a dot.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A strip across the top of a page or pane, or a tinted panel, about the state of the whole thing, in five tones, with an action and a dismiss button.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail of links from the top of a site to the current page.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The 32px button with primary, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive and link variants, and a loading state.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for choosing a day or a range of days, with full keyboard navigation, lists that jump to a month and a year, and the caller's locale.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A thin-bordered panel without a fill, optionally rendered as a link. The title takes asChild to match the heading level.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox control.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code to read and copy: a pre that scrolls sideways, with an optional header and a corner slot for a CopyButton, which copies the code beside it.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A region shown and hidden by any button, with state the page can control.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A select with a search field, for lists too long to scan. It goes back to its default on a form reset.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A search field over a keyboard-driven list of options, for command palettes and searchable lists.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: A second look before an action, controlled or behind a button, with focus returning to what opened it.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies a value and shows the outcome in the icon, a bubble and a status region, with every word passed in.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date field: a button that opens a Calendar in a popover, and goes back to its default on a form reset.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A field for a span of days: a button that opens a Calendar in range mode in a popover, and submits the two days as a pair of form fields.

items.name: date-time-picker
items.title: Date Time Picker
items.description: A date and a time of day in one field, valued as local text like <input type="datetime-local">, that follows a form reset.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Names and their values in a dl, the values starting on one line, with an optional control beside each value.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with a translatable close button.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: Questions and answers on native details, with no client JavaScript.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions or choices opened from a trigger.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What a list or page shows when it has nothing to show: an icon tile, a title, a sentence and the next step, large or compact.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not Found
items.description: The page a product shows for an address it does not have: the brand mark, the status code, a title, a sentence, the way back, and where else to go or the same words in the other language.

items.name: expandable-text
items.title: Expandable Text
items.description: A long text clamped to a few lines, with a show more / show less button only when it runs past them.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control and the line under it with their ids wired, the error replacing the description, and a setting row with a switch.

items.name: field-message
items.title: Field Message
items.description: The line under a form field: a dot and one sentence, with the color following the tone.

items.name: file-button
items.title: File Button
items.description: A Button that opens the file chooser and hands back the files, or submits them with its form.

items.name: form-reset
items.title: Form Reset
items.description: useFormReset: the hook that puts a field holding its value in React state back on its default when its form is reset, and leaves it alone when the page cancels the reset.

items.name: guarded-dialog
items.title: Guarded Dialog
items.description: A dialog that cannot be closed while it is saving, with a hook that keys its form per open.

items.name: info-hint
items.title: Info Hint
items.description: The small ⓘ next to a title: a note that opens on hover and focus, and toggles on a tap.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text input.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input sharing one border with a fixed suffix or quiet text buttons.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code field drawn as boxes: one real input that takes a paste and the code from a message.

items.name: item-list
items.title: Item List
items.description: A short bordered list with a line between rows, each row a link, a button or plain, with a title, a description, meta and a chevron.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key cap and a combination of keys, with useModifierKey to tell the platform's modifier.

items.name: json-ld
items.title: JSON-LD
items.description: A page's structured data as a <script type="application/ld+json">, escaped for the script element.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label.

items.name: language-picker
items.title: Language Picker
items.description: A languages button and menu holding no state: the page passes the current language and writes back the choice, or gives each language its page.

items.name: link-row
items.title: Link Row
items.description: A table row that opens its page when clicked anywhere, keeping the real link for the keyboard and new tabs.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled like Input.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The top of a product page: the h1, a description, the page's actions and a way back, sticky if asked.

items.name: nav-tabs
items.title: Nav Tabs
items.description: Tabs and segmented controls made of links, for views with their own address, with the current one marked by aria-current.

items.name: facet-list
items.title: Facet List
items.description: The column beside a list that narrows it: groups of views or values with a count each, a selected row and a show-more row for long groups.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links under a list or table, with the current page marked.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show and hide button in its border, and room for actions such as generate.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A thin bar in the signal color, determinate from 0 to 100 or sweeping while indeterminate, with warning and destructive tones for usage meters.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A QR code drawn as inline SVG on the server, dark on white in both themes.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice among a few: a quiet ring that fills with an ink dot, moved with the arrow keys.

items.name: resize-handle
items.title: Resize Handle
items.description: A focusable separator that sizes a pane by drag or keyboard, with usePointerDrag for handles of a project's own.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrolling box with thin bars of its own, reachable from the keyboard, with an optional edge fade and a one-line strip mode.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A search box with the search icon, a clear button of its own and room for a shortcut hint.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A custom select with a popover list.

items.name: selection-bar
items.title: Selection Bar
items.description: The toolbar above a list that acts on the rows checked in it: a select-all checkbox, the count, actions and clear.

items.name: list-navigation
items.title: List Navigation
items.description: useListNavigation: J and K move a list's current row, Enter opens it, Escape lets go and / goes to its search, except while typing or in a dialog or menu.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical, decorative unless told otherwise.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A drawer attached to the left or right edge, with a translatable close button.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's column that collapses to an icon rail: a module switcher, nav rows that carry a count or a dot, named groups, a More row for the rest, and useSidebar for rows of a project's own.

items.name: side-pane
items.title: Side Pane
items.description: A pane beside a list that folds to a narrow rail and opens again: facets on one side, the current row's details on the other, remembered in a cookie.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: The first link on a page, hidden above the top until it takes the keyboard focus.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value or a range picked along a track.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Toast notifications on sonner, following the page theme without a theme library.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small ring that spins in the current text color.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: The headline numbers of a page: tiles with a name, a value, a hint and a change, as cards or one joined block.

items.name: status-label
items.title: Status Label
items.description: A colored dot and one word that state a status.

items.name: card-list
items.title: Card List
items.description: Small cards on the canvas, one per conversation or ticket: a first line with a time, a line or two under it, and a selected card on the paper of the sheet with a mark in the signal color.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status Bar
items.description: The strip along the bottom of an app window: entries, a spacer, separators and the keys that work on the screen.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a fixed sequence of steps, such as checkout or onboarding.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off toggle, controlled or uncontrolled, that submits like a checkbox when given a name and goes back to its default on a form reset.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Tables with plain and bordered variants, pinned columns and link-based sortable headers. table-row.ts holds the row action class and row click helper, usable from Server Components.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one subject that swap in place, with the current tab marked in the signal color.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A chip for a chosen value with a named remove button, and the list that holds them.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input.

items.name: theme-picker
items.title: Theme Picker
items.description: The system, light and dark menu behind a header button, holding no state: the page passes the saved preference and writes back the choice.

items.name: theme-script
items.title: Theme Script
items.description: ThemeScript, the inline <head> script that applies the saved or system theme before the first paint and keeps it in the browser, and useThemePreference, its preference for a ThemePicker.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: A time of day: the browser's time input to type into, with a list of times in the theme's popover in place of the browser's picker, valued as "09:30" and following a form reset.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events in order on a rail, each marked by a toned dot or an icon, with a title, a time and a message.

items.name: clip-track
items.title: Clip Track
items.description: A strip of clips in playing order, each as wide as it is long, with a time ruler, a state bar per clip and a playhead.

items.name: toc
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: The links to a document's sections, marking the one being read with aria-current="location" as the page scrolls.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, taking the soft highlight of a selection while on.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles joined into one segmented control, one pressed at a time or several.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls with one tab stop and arrow keys between them, in groups split by separators.

items.name: list-toolbar
items.title: List Toolbar
items.description: The row over a list: the search, the filters and the actions on the whole list, in the same places on every list, filter chips that open their choices, and the chips of the conditions in force.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint shown on hover or focus. Works on its own; TooltipProvider shares the delay across an area.

items.name: turnstile
items.title: Turnstile
items.description: The Cloudflare Turnstile check for a form, as a component and a hook: one script load, the page's theme, the token in a hidden field, and reset.

items.name: truncated-text
items.title: Truncated Text
items.description: A line cut with an ellipsis that shows the whole text in a tooltip only when it was cut.

items.name: uptime-bar
items.title: Uptime Bar
items.description: A service's history as a strip of up, degraded, down and empty bars, and the uptime in its color, with no script.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: The 1184px page column with responsive gutters.

items.name: icon-tile
items.title: Icon Tile
items.description: A square tile that holds an icon.

items.name: pricing-card
items.title: Pricing Card
items.description: One plan on a pricing page: name, price, period, features and a call to action, with a featured state and an optional discount.

items.name: bento
items.title: Bento
items.description: A wall of feature tiles for a landing page: tiles with a title, a sentence and a visual at the foot, some spanning two columns.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Styles for long-form copy such as rendered MDX or Markdown, code blocks and tables included.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: Section Heading
items.description: The eyebrow label, page and section titles, the lead under a page title and section spacing.

items.name: text-link
items.title: Text Link
items.description: A quiet link that brightens on hover, and an underlined one for inside a sentence.
